descricao_original: Clusters of endocrine cells and endocrine organs are supplied by fenestrated capillaries, which greatly facilitate the entry of hormone into the blood stream. In endocrine organs these fenestrations have a nonmembranous diaphragm across the opening. Endocrine pancreas 28,000x
